name: Large Scale Optimization - Linear and Integer Programming
description: The course will cover several exact algorithms that are used in solving integer and mixed integer linear programs. Some of the algorithms taught in this course would be: Lagrangian Relaxation, Cutting Plane approach, Benders Decomposition, Logic Based Benders Decomposition, and Column Generation.
